name: Iizuka Sakura
source: Daughter of Ayano. Like her mother she is very kind and friendly. She has taken a particular interest in Kaito, seeming to be the only student in class that sees him in a good light.
translation: Daughter of Ayano. Like her mother she is very kind and friendly. She has taken a particular interest in Kaito, seeming to be the only student in class that sees him in a good light.
